fields.label: Picture layout
fields.description: How your wallpapers and kpopping photos are laid out. Classic: Ambxst's square cards. Rows: equal-height rows, every picture in its own shape. Masonry: Pinterest-style columns, every picture in its own shape.

fields.label: YouTube layout
fields.description: Squares: like the other grids. Tiles: 16:9 thumbnails with title, channel and length underneath. List: like YouTube's search results, thumbnail on the left, details on the right.

fields.label: Wallpaper card size
fields.description: Compact is Ambxst's 7 cards a row (YouTube list: 3 columns of rows; Comfortable 2, Large 1). Bigger cards and the Rows / Masonry layouts use 480 px thumbnails the mod makes for your library once (about 5 minutes for ~6,000 wallpapers, ~25 KB each, in ~/.cache/ambxst/kpopping/local-thumbs).

fields.label: YouTube card size
fields.description: Card size for YouTube results only (squares, tiles or list). Same as pictures follows Wallpaper card size.

fields.label: Wallpaper fit
fields.description: How skwd-wall puts every wallpaper on the screen (applies to all wallpapers, not only kpopping ones). Auto fills the screen unless that would cut off more than 20% of the image (your screen's shape decides), else shows it whole. A fit you pick for one wallpaper (Super+Alt+F, or the fit button in the notch while previewing) is remembered and wins over this.

fields.label: Around a fitted image
fields.description: What fills the bars beside a wallpaper that doesn't cover the whole screen (Fit, Center, Auto's portrait images).

fields.label: YouTube wallpaper quality
fields.description: Auto fetches at most your screen's resolution: more pixels than the screen has only cost decoding power. VP9 and H.264 are preferred over AV1 at that size, since many GPUs decode them in hardware but not AV1.

fields.label: Pause YouTube wallpaper when covered
fields.description: Pause the video while a fullscreen window (or, with skwd-wall's 'maximized' pause mode, a maximized one) covers its screen, and in game mode. Off: it keeps playing.

fields.label: YouTube cache size
fields.description: Videos are downloaded into ~/.cache/ambxst/kpopping/yt so they start, seek and switch instantly, and the next ones download ahead. The oldest are deleted first when the cache is full; the playing and upcoming videos never are.
